verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of per-employee workstation checks such as disk encryption, screen lock or password manager, and no endpoint agent is mentioned. The only possibly related item is a bare 'JumpCloud Integration' doc title, which does not say that device posture is tracked. Generic 'continuous monitoring' claims are not specific to workstations, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
